approval_context: Owner-approved visual revisions to centered slim arms, perspective label, and direction-correct rear barcode.
reusable_insights: Arm attachment points on a narrow isometric side must sit inside the side plane, rather than at its rear corner; keep the seam visible after compositing.
Glyphs on a slanted vertical package face retain upright stems; project each glyph pixel column along that plane's slope.
A rear barcode has vertical printed bars. Compute its pitch in final viewing coordinates, so NE and NW have opposite slopes after mirroring.
compatibility: No visual change to approved 384x4928 v6b sheet or native expression overlays; compare regenerated PNGs pixel for pixel.
limitations: Other non-walk animation rows remain simplified placeholders; this promotion does not certify those gameplay actions.
